request: Prepare a planning lesson on comparing mulch types. Require a source-based critique, feasible allocation and a blank tray record. Students are not asked to grow plants or report future results.
objective: Identify watering as a competing factor and design a tray-level comparison without treating seedlings within a tray as independently assigned units.

sources.text: Fictional nursery note: trays with bark mulch given100ml water daily had a median of8 emerged seedlings at day seven; trays with fibre mulch given150ml had a median of11. Original tray counts and individual results were not preserved.

Sixteen new identical trays are available, each containing twenty seeds from one seed lot. A mulch treatment and water volume are applied to a whole tray. Both mulches can use either daily volume. Keep tray dimensions, soil, light schedule, seed count and observation day the same; trays can be randomly placed on the same shelf.

Count a seedling as emerged when its shoot is visibly above the soil at the day-seven observation. Record tray ID, mulch, daily water, shelf position and count, including zero. No new growth observations have been made.
